prompt: Why does the man mention his paperback copy?
promptZh: 男子為什麼特別提到他的平裝本？

options.text: He wants to read a map from that copy.
options.zh: 他想讀那個版本裡的地圖。
options.whyZh: 地圖出現在女子的大字版，不是男子提起平裝本的理由。

options.text: His page reference may not match another edition.
options.zh: 他的頁碼在其他版本可能對不上。
options.whyZh: 平裝本第六十頁是他筆記記的位置；女子的大字版同頁是地圖。

options.text: He wants the woman to borrow that edition tonight.
options.zh: 他要女子今晚借用那一版。
options.whyZh: 女子用自己的大字版按章名找，男子沒有要求換書。

options.text: It does not include an editor’s note.
options.whyZh: 沒有說平裝本有沒有編者註；確定的是兩版頁碼不同。

explanationZh: 平裝本第六十頁是他筆記記的位置；女子的大字版同頁是地圖。
evidence: Could you read the opening bit of the chapter tonight? My notes say page sixty, but that’s in my paperback. / My large-print copy has a map on that page. I found the chapter by its title, but there’s an editor’s note between the title and the story.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Could you read the opening bit of the chapter tonight? My notes say page sixty, but that’s in my paperback.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: My large-print copy has a map on that page. I found the chapter by its title, but there’s an editor’s note between the title and the story.
